integrity: The included checker uses exact arithmetic; complete low-dimensional transforms and parameter arithmetic corroborate but do not independently certify the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for additive rank-at-most-two matrix balls over finite fields, with 3<=m<=n. Classical rank-metric Fourier polynomials are prior art. The sign and sharp norm conclusions await independent validation and exhaustive historical-priority verification.
title: Zero-free Fourier kernels of rank-two matrix balls and a binary square transition
